pieces.title: Dancing w/ The Stars 2012
pieces.description:
Supernerd was hired to design the stage visuals for Chris Brown’s Dancing with the Stars performance, creating broadcast-ready graphics inspired by the symbols from his Fortune album and a world of colorful speakers. The visual direction was built to feel bold, energetic, and musically driven, translating the spirit of the performance into dynamic screen content for live television.

The work focused on developing vibrant stage visuals that complemented the choreography and amplified the performance’s rhythm and energy. By pulling from the Fortune iconography and speaker-based graphic elements, Supernerd helped create a playful, high-impact visual environment that supported Chris Brown’s performance and enhanced the overall televised moment.
